oneLineSummary: GraphRAG 4 production pitfall: LLM extraction cost (94% performance achievable via dependency parsing baseline), schema evolution requires full re-index (-16.6% time-sensitive accuracy), hallucination residual (C2RAG mitigates), latency linear with corpus.
recommendation: hybrid: dependency parsing extraction + C2RAG constraint + delta-indexing + KG summary cache + lightweight subgraph projection.
